q: What age groups do the camps cater for?
a: Camps are designed for children aged 7–12. We do take younger siblings from age 6 — please contact us before booking to discuss your child's needs.

q: Does my child need any prior experience?
a: Absolutely no experience necessary! All activities are guided by expert staff and every child progresses at their own pace. The only requirement is a sense of adventure!

q: Should the children bring a packed lunch?
a: Yes — there are two breaks throughout the day, so bring plenty of food and liquids. We also operate a strict No Nuts Policy as several children suffer from severe nut allergies. Please ensure no nut products are included.

q: What clothing and supplies should my child bring?
a: Clothes for all weather — good walking boots or wellies and suncream are essential. Please notify SIA staff in advance of any allergy or medical condition your child has.
